testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for the Origin center point: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:569:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for the Origin center point ✔ Given a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the Center Point row ✔ Then a context menu opens beside the point row ✔ And the menu offers Copy, Measure, Create Note, Visibility and Relationships ✔ And the Center Point row is highlighted ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the Center Point row remains highlighted ✔ When the user clicks the empty viewport area again ✔ Then the Center Point row no longer has the filled selection highlight ✔ And the Center Point row retains a focus outline ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport
